title: Single-File Cache Purge Delays
summary: Cloudflare identified an issue that delayed a small subset of single file cache purge requests between 19:21 and 20:21 UTC on November 22, 2026. Affected requests were submitted through Cloudflare data centers in parts of Europe, the Middle East and Africa. For these requests, cached content in other Cloudflare data centers worldwide could remain stale for up to approximately 60 minutes before the purge completed. All delayed purges have since completed, and this incident has been resolved.
